name: Flathead County, MT
findings: Flathead County has 365 nonprofit organizations. 150 of them (41%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 117 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (17% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Flathead County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
26% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 17 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.

confidence.text: Based on 17 organizations here; 45% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do religious organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?

observations.title: Fewer organizations list civic or political action
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in Flathead County list civic or political action on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 70% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 9 organizations here; 45% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find ways to take civic or political action now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.title: Professional organizations stand out for public events
observations.text: 7 professional organizations here list public events, compared with about 3 in similar places of this size.

confidence.text: Based on 7 organizations here; 45% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What role do professional organizations play in community life here? Who do they reach, and who might they miss?
